newsitem.title: CANADA: Montreal exchange to halt Bre-X, Bresea.
newsitem.headline: Montreal exchange to halt Bre-X, Bresea.

text.p: The Montreal Exchange said it decided, in accord with the Toronto Stock Exchange, to halt trading of Bre-X Minerals Ltd common stock at the market open on Monday, after news Bre-X's Busang gold deposit was a hoax.

The exchange said it would also apply the trading halt to the securities of Bresea Resources Ltd, following the release of a report by independent analyst Strathcona Minerals on Bre-X's Busang gold field in Indonesia.
Bresea is a member of the Bre-X group of companies.
Strathcona said it believed core samples from the Busang area were tampered with and assay results were falsified on an unprecedented scale.
An economic deposit could not be found, it said in a report to Canadian gold prospector Bre-X. Bre-X claimed to have discovered a 71 million ounce motherlode at the site.
Montreal Exchange said it would review the preliminary report with the other exchanges to determine the duration of the suspension.
